about_opg.title: Over a decade of execution. Not just advice.
about_opg.body:
Founded in 2018, OPG is a Birmingham-based property development and advisory business. Our background spans planning, quantity surveying, development management and construction consultancy.

We have contributed to projects up to £42m in value across residential, commercial, care and mixed-use development. We work with a select group of investors and landowners, applying the same commercial discipline to every instruction.

statement.title: گەشە دەدەین. ڕاوێژ دەدەین. وەبەرهێنان دەکەین.
statement.body: Combining planning, development, quantity surveying and investment expertise to help landowners, investors and businesses unlock the full potential of land and property.

story.title: Built through experience. Driven by execution.
story.body:
Opulent Property Group was founded on the belief that the best property advice comes from people who have delivered projects themselves. Our background spans planning, quantity surveying, development management, construction consultancy and property investment, giving clients practical advice grounded in real-world experience.

Over the past decade, we have contributed to projects up to £42m in value across residential, commercial, care and mixed-use development. Whether supporting landowners through planning, advising investors on acquisitions or managing developments from concept to completion, we apply the same commercial discipline to every instruction.

Today, OPG works with landowners, developers, investors and businesses across England, combining technical expertise with long-term thinking to unlock the full potential of land and property.

about.mission: OPG هەیە بۆ نیشاندانی ئەوەی گەشەپێدانی خانووبەرە دەکرێت بەبێ قەرزی سوودار — و پێکهاتەی وەبەرهێنانی ئەخلاقی و هاوبەشی دەتوانێت باشتر بێت لە شێوازە باوەکان کاتێک لەگەڵ شارەزایی ڕاستەقینەی گەشەپێدان تێکەڵ دەبێت.

hero.title: خزمەتگوزاری پیشەیی خانووبەرە
hero.body: Delivered by practitioners, not generalists. Every instruction handled with the same rigour we apply to our own investments.

development.title:
We source off-market.
We structure without interest.

sellers.title: Bring your property to us.
sellers.body: We are actively acquiring land, commercial buildings and residential assets across Birmingham and the Midlands. We move quickly, transact with certainty, and don't waste your time. We are particularly interested in sites and assets not yet on the open market — motivated sellers, probate, vacant and distressed assets welcome.

points.p2: Probate, vacant, and distressed assets welcome

investors.title: We don't often open to new investors.
investors.body: Our acquisition pipeline is built on off-market relationships and proprietary deal flow. We identify deeply discounted and structurally undervalued assets, execute disciplined refurbishment programmes, and exit or hold for income. Our investor base is small by design.

points.p4: Investors are accepted by pre-qualification only. Minimum investable capital of £100,000 applies.

consultancy.title: The technical backbone behind successful developments.
consultancy.intro: We provide comprehensive consultancy to developers, contractors, and funding institutions across the full development lifecycle. Whether you need a QS from day one or a bank monitor from drawdown, we have the experience to deliver.

planning.title: Planning Applications
planning.body: Preparation, coordination and submission of full planning applications, prior approvals, and change of use consents. Residential, commercial, and mixed-use.

pre_app.title: Pre-Application Advice
pre_app.body: Strategic guidance before submission. We assess viability, identify risk, and engage with local planning authorities on your behalf.

qs.title: Quantity Surveying & Cost Management
qs.body: Detailed cost plans, bills of quantities, tender analysis and cost reporting. From feasibility through to final account.

procurement.title: Contractor Procurement
procurement.body: Tender preparation, contractor selection, contract negotiation and appointment. We protect your interests throughout.

contract.title: Contract Administration
contract.body: Acting as contract administrator or employer's agent on JCT and bespoke contracts. Valuations, instructions, and dispute avoidance.

bank.title: Bank Monitoring & Lender Reporting
bank.body: Independent monitoring for development lenders. Progress reports, cost-to-complete assessments, and draw-down certification.

advisory.title: Supporting clients at every stage of the property journey.

sourcing.title: Property Sourcing
sourcing.body: We identify and acquire properties on behalf of clients — residential, commercial, and investment. On and off-market.

lease.title: Commercial Lease Review
lease.body: Expert review of commercial leases and contracts. We identify risk, negotiate terms, and protect your position.

valuations.title: Property Valuations & Appraisals
valuations.body: Development appraisals and commercial valuations. With or without planning permission. Residual and comparable methodology.

liaison.title: Planning Authority Liaison
liaison.body: Navigating enforcement, compliance queries, planning disputes and local authority correspondence on your behalf.

project_mgmt.title: Project & Development Management
project_mgmt.body: Managing projects from acquisition to completion, coordinating consultants, contractors and budgets to protect your investment.

due_diligence.title: Investment Due Diligence
due_diligence.body: Commercial, planning and technical due diligence to support informed property and development acquisitions.

hero.eyebrow: Care Home • Supported Living • Extra Care
hero.title: گەشەپێدان و وەبەرهێنان لە کەرتی چاودێری
hero.body: From identifying suitable development sites to securing planning permission, introducing operators and structuring investment, we deliver care sector projects from concept through to completion.

operators.title: You Define. We Source. We Deliver.
operators.body: Whether you're expanding an existing portfolio or opening a new service, we act as your property and development partner. Tell us your preferred location, bed numbers, building type, budget and programme—we'll identify suitable opportunities, secure the site, manage planning and coordinate the development through to handover.

investors.title: Acquire. Create Value. Hold.
investors.body: Care and supported living assets offer some of the most resilient income profiles in the property market. Demand is structural, tenants are institutional, and leases are long. We identify, acquire and develop care sector assets on behalf of investors — then hold them for income or exit at a premium. Every investment is equity-based and interest-free.

points.p3: Long-term rental income and capital growth

s1.title: Tell Us What You Need
s1.body: Tell us your preferred location, capacity, operational requirements and timescales. We assess your brief and advise on the best delivery strategy.

s2.title: Site & Opportunity Matching
s2.body: We identify suitable on and off-market sites that match your brief. Every opportunity is assessed commercially, operationally and from a planning perspective.

s3.title: Acquisition & Planning
s3.body: We negotiate the acquisition, coordinate consultants and manage the planning process to create a clear route to delivery.

s4.title: Development & Compliance
s4.body: We oversee design, procurement, planning conditions and construction management through to a completed, operator-ready asset.

s5.title: Tenancy & Income
s5.body: Operators move into a completed facility. Investors benefit from long-term ownership while we continue to provide asset management support where required.

form.title: Discuss Your Site
form.intro: Whether you're a care operator planning your next development or an investor exploring opportunities in the care sector, we'd welcome the opportunity to speak. We take on a limited number of partnerships, ensuring every project receives our full commitment.

bromyard.title: Bromyard Care Village
bromyard.location: Porthouse Farm, Tenbury Road, Bromyard, Herefordshire
bromyard.body: A mixed-use care-led development comprising a 78-bed C2 care home, 3 bungalows, a 1,116 sqm Class E foodstore shell, and conversion of an existing building. The scheme addresses acute care capacity needs in rural Herefordshire and represents a significant community infrastructure investment. Full consultant team appointed. Planning resubmission targeting August–September 2026.

selective.body: We prioritise quality over quantity and pursue only projects that meet our investment criteria.

philosophy.title: Our investment philosophy
philosophy.body:
We believe successful property investment begins long before construction starts. Through careful site selection, planning expertise and strong project management, we focus on creating value at every stage of the development lifecycle.

Rather than pursuing volume, we concentrate on projects where our experience and network can make the greatest difference.

value.title: Acquire. Create Value. Exit.
value.subtitle: Investment Strategy I — Value Creation
value.body: We acquire underperforming residential and commercial assets where value can be created through planning, refurbishment, active asset management and disciplined project delivery before disposal.

hold.title: Acquire. Create Value. Hold.
hold.subtitle: Investment Strategy II — Income & Hold
hold.body: We acquire underperforming residential, commercial and care assets where active asset management, refurbishment and planning can create long-term value. Rather than disposing of completed projects, selected assets are retained to generate sustainable rental income while benefiting from long-term capital growth.

s3.title: Due Diligence
s3.body: Where appropriate, prospective investment partners receive detailed project information, legal documentation and any applicable disclosures for independent review.
